reviews.title: Worst app in the store
reviews.text: You would be hard-pressed to try and make an app that was worse than the MGM+ app / especially if your Verizon FIOS subscriber with a TV plan that gives you access to MGM. For several years, it has given me nothing but headaches every single time I try to use this piece of trash. The worst part is that their support department is completely inept, incapable, and unwilling to do anything to help you. For a company as large as this it’s a complete travesty that this app is complete trash. As someone that has paid for this service but has never been able to reliably use it for more than one session at a time due to it not liking my Verizon FIOS for some reason / it refuses to work in anything remotely close to reliable. There should be a class action lawsuit against MGM for the failures. I am being charged for a service that I cannot use / I have attempted for months to get help from their Support department in the email exchanges would blow your mind. I urge anybody who can get a class action lawsuit going to contact me immediately. The proof that I have of their incompetence in unwillingness to help WILL seal the deal.

reviews.title: Great service but not great partnering
reviews.text: Prime got me hooked on season 1 of From. Since it was leaving I decided to download the MGM+ app so I can continue. I was unaware however that my LG tv does not support the app. Online directed me to use another service that supports MGM+, which would be Prime. I open prime to login to my MGM+ annual account that I already paid in full for, to learn that I can’t log in to an exciting account, I have to create one through their service portal. Now I am unable to get a refund.. and unable to watch on my TV… I’m not going to buy a new tv to watch a show.. but now I wasted $62 on an app that I can only watch on my phone. I haven’t even used the app for more than 10 mins and I still can’t get a refund. I’m very bummed and very frustrated and wish there was more comparability or transparency with compatibility. Everything has an app now, such a shame that the LG tvs can’t support this one.
